title: Event 25 September: The Individual in the Machine – Meredith Whittaker on reclaiming Privacy in the Age of AI
description: Invitation by AlgorithmWatch to join an exclusive talk with Meredith Whittaker, President of the messenger platform, Signal. On 25 September at 6.30pm Meredith Whittaker, Maria Exner (Publix) und Matthias Spielkamp (AlgorithmWatch) will discuss what we must do to bring technology in line with human needs - particularly in protecting the privacy of individuals from powerful platforms and operating system providers. Newsletter subscribers can join the livestream!
